research_result.description: Front is a customer communication platform and shared inbox solution. It provides a Core REST API, Webhooks, Plugin SDK, Channel API, and a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allow developers and AI agents to manage conversations, contacts, channels, comments, tags, and inboxes.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can register for a free developer account to obtain a sandbox testing environment. API credentials can be generated directly as company-level API Tokens via Settings > Developers or created via OAuth credentials within a developer app.

evidence.claim: Front supports OAuth 2.0 and API Tokens for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API Tokens.

evidence.claim: Front Core API uses Bearer tokens passed in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.

evidence.claim: Front offers a REST Core API providing endpoints for managing conversations, contacts, custom fields, and attachments.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: After completing this tutorial, you will be ready to build your own integration using the Core API endpoints.

evidence.claim: Free developer environments are self-serve and accessible by signing up.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.

evidence.claim: Front offers an official MCP server for AI agents to interact with Front data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Front's MCP server lets you and your teammates connect Front to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
